summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PURE LIFE OS City Hub Upgrade features: Notifications API, TopBar with bell icon, Recruitment 2.0 with Interview workflow, and Appointments Calendar. Fixed critical database migration issue - missing interview columns in recruitment_applications table. All 43 backend tests pass (12 new + 31 existing). Frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/notifications/count - Returns unread and total count
GET /api/notifications/list - Returns list of notifications with correct structure
PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read - Marks notification as read
PUT /api/notifications/read-all - Marks all notifications as read
GET /api/recruitment/stats - Returns stats including interview count
POST /api/recruitment/apply - Creates application and generates notification
PUT /api/recruitment/{id}/review - Sets application to interview status with scheduled date
GET /api/recruitment/my-applications - Response includes interview fields
GET /api/appointments/calendar/{sector} - Returns accepted appointments with scheduled dates
PUT /api/appointments/{id}/handle - Accepting generates notification
GET /api/appointments/stats - Returns appointment statistics
Notification types correctly set (recruitment_new, recruitment_interview, appointment_new, appointment_accepted)
UI: TopBar visible on City Hub page with menu hamburger
UI: Notifications bell hidden for unauthenticated users
UI: Notifications bell visible for authenticated users with unread count badge
UI: Notifications dropdown shows list with mark-all-as-read option
UI: Recruitment page shows Interview (Colloquio) stat card
UI: Recruitment page has status filter with Interview option
UI: Recruitment page has sort by date button
UI: Recruitment profile modal shows all candidate details
UI: Appointments Calendar tab visible
UI: Calendar month view with day grid and appointments
UI: Calendar shows appointments on correct dates with times
UI: Status badges have correct colors (yellow=pending, blue=reviewing, purple=interview, green=accepted, red=rejected)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Database migration - Added missing columns to recruitment_applications table: interview_assigned_to, interview_assigned_name, interview_notes, interview_scheduled_at. SQLAlchemy create_all is idempotent but doesn't add new columns to existing tables.
updated_files: /app/backend/purelife_os.db - Added 4 interview columns to recruitment_applications table
/app/backend/tests/test_notifications_and_upgrades.py - Created comprehensive test suite for new features
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing (prefixed with TEST_) for notifications, recruitment applications, and appointments
context_for_next_testing_agent: City Hub Upgrade fully functional. New features tested: 1) Notifications API with count, list, mark-read, mark-all-read endpoints. 2) TopBar with notifications bell (visible only for authenticated users) and quick menu. 3) Recruitment 2.0 with Interview status in workflow (pending -> reviewing -> interview -> accepted/rejected), status filters, date sorting, and profile modal. 4) Appointments Calendar with monthly grid view showing scheduled appointments. All notifications are generated automatically when: creating applications, changing application status, requesting appointments, accepting/rejecting appointments.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: The recruitment_applications table was missing the new interview-related columns (interview_assigned_to, interview_assigned_name, interview_notes, interview_scheduled_at) that were added to the model. SQLAlchemy's create_all() is idempotent for creating tables but does not add new columns to existing tables. Fix: Manually added the missing columns using ALTER TABLE statements.
